### Short Answer
The deadline for filing BIR Form 1701, which is the annual income tax return for individuals, is on or before the fifteenth (15th) day of April of each year.

### Controlling Authorities
This requirement is established under Section 51(C)(1) of the National Internal Revenue Code (NIRC), which specifies that the return must be filed by April 15 of each year covering income for the preceding taxable year.

### Interpretation
Section 51 of the NIRC outlines the filing obligations for individual taxpayers, including Filipino citizens and resident aliens, who must report their income from all sources. The April 15 deadline is crucial for compliance with tax obligations and ensures that taxpayers fulfill their responsibilities in a timely manner.

### Practical Meaning
Taxpayers should prepare and file BIR Form 1701 by the April 15 deadline to avoid penalties and interest for late filing. It is advisable to complete the return well in advance of the deadline to address any potential issues that may arise during the filing process.
